comment.body: This is covered by the merged Scoop Extras packaging fix in PR 18020. Multiple reporters confirmed that `scoop update` followed by `scoop update powertoys --force` removes the prompt. The missing WinUI payload is package-manager-specific, so there is no evidence for a competing PowerToys source change; other package managers should compare their manifests with the corrected file set.
